note: Rewritten from Sands' English revision of 1959 (Amitermes evuncifer Silvestri); the original description is Silvestri 1912, Ann. Mus. civ. Stor. nat. Genova 45: 211-255; the present work supplements Sjöstedt's description and gives measurement ranges and means, and this entry takes only the ranges. Synonyms and literature history are given in the original.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate: fontanelle long-oval, often partly or completely depressed, smaller than the ocelli; third marginal tooth of the left mandible projecting beyond the cutting edge between it and the first marginal tooth; the distance between the apex of the apical tooth and that of the first marginal tooth less than the distance between the first and third marginal teeth. Soldier: size variation far greater than previously recorded, fore coxa without spines.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: In addition to Sjöstedt's description: fontanelle long-oval, often partly or completely depressed, smaller than the ocelli; third marginal tooth of the left mandible projecting beyond the cutting edge joining the first marginal tooth; the distance between the apex of the apical tooth and that of the first marginal tooth less than the distance between the apices of the first and third marginal teeth. Measurements: head width (including compound eyes) 1.02—1.11, greatest diameter of the compound eye 0.28—0.31, ocellus length 0.06—0.09, width 0.10—0.16, ocellus–eye distance 0.02—0.07, pronotum width 0.86—0.97, length 0.54—0.61, hind tibia length 1.00—1.14, forewing length 8.00—10.7.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Size variation much greater than previously recorded; fore coxa without spines. Measurements: head length 1.14—1.66, greatest head width 1.02—1.30, mandible basal width 0.70—0.87, head thickness 0.82—1.00, left mandible length 0.61—0.75, pronotum length 0.30—0.40, width 0.61—0.75.
